comments.content: The endpoint name is user-controlled and does not reliably identify its API shape. A valid Azure AI Foundry DeepSeek endpoint can be named `my-endpoint...models.ai.azure.com` and would still select `AzureOpenAI`, while an Azure OpenAI resource whose name contains `deepseek` would incorrectly select `OpenAI`. Detect the Foundry endpoint host/path (or expose an explicit client type) rather than checking for `deepseek`.

This check is case-sensitive, but Azure's canonical model/deployment name is commonly `DeepSeek-R1`, so it will not enter the reasoner-specific path. Normalize `modelId` with `toLowerCase()` before checking (and likewise consider that Azure deployment names may be customized).
